items.title: Louis Keppard Interview, 1961-01-19
items.q: Pico asked me to play something... Pico was playing, and I, I take the guitar... Pico started playing. Then I started making them double raps.

ctx.x: But it was a slow funeral of dirt.

No, I remember four times. Yeah. Flow four. Now, Mario would make the lead. Of course they used Pico and all that, but now and that, but they didn't lead no more than him. And he used to have that clarinet going. Now another one he was good too, and he was clumsy, Lorenzo Teo. He was tough. His daddy was alright, but not like Lorenzo Teo. See but the whole thing is Lorenzo Teo, he was just like Bechet. Bechet is one of them. He was a good clarinet. Of course I understand. He went away and he played for the Queen,…
Unless they knock your brains loose.
